# oldpak/cache

> 标签: abstraction, apcu, cache, caching, couchdb, memcached, php, redis, xcache

## 简介

PHP Doctrine Cache library is a popular cache implementation that supports many different drivers such as redis, memcache, apc, mongodb and others.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 7；已收录于 php-v7, php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://www.doctrine-project.org/projects/cache.html
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/oldpak/cache.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/oldpak%2Fcache
